title: board review looks for the card's pull request before refusing
notes: Just after a worker opens its PR, board review refuses 'has no pull request on <branch> yet' (review-flow.ts ~347) because the app's follow has not yet moved the card to Review; board set --pull-request does not help while the card is in Doing (found on #334). Run the card's follow (card.follow) for that card before deciding to refuse, so a PR that exists is found. Ship after #334 merges: it changes the same refusal text.
